rules.title: Half size when BOTH the 10-day (> 0.45) and the 20-day (> 0.35) efficiency say trending

rules.title: 70% size when trading against the RTH direction so far

rules.title: Half size when the 20-day efficiency is above 0.35 (on top of the live 10-day rule)

rules.title: Half size on a trend day at entry (day efficiency >= 0.35 and range >= 0.8 ADR)

rules.title: Half size when VIX is 20+ (prior close), on the locked rules

rules.title: Half size when VIX rose more than 5% the day before

rules.title: 125% size when VIX rose more than 5% the day before

rules.title: Half size when VXN/VIX sits between 1.25 and 1.35

rules.title: Half size when VXN/VIX is 1.35+ (Nasdaq fear premium)

rules.title: Half size when VXN/VIX is below 1.15

rules.title: Half size when the opening range (09:30-10:00) is wider than 0.35 ADR20

rules.title: 125% size when dealer gamma was negative the day before

rules.title: 125% size when NQ reclaims harder than ES on the sweep -> trigger leg, info
